about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Return to where true survival began.
Set 2.4 million years ago, Primal Survival takes you deep into the dawn of humanity. Step into the bare footprints of Homo habilis or Homo erectus, and experience a world where survival isn't optional—it's instinct.

Unlike modern survival games, this is not about fictional crafting with sci-fi gadgets. Primal Survival is about realistic, primitive survival. You must craft with stone, build shelter, hunt, and protect your tribe. But be warned—you're not always the hunter. Sometimes, you're the prey.

KEY FEATURES

🪨 Authentic Survival Experience
Stay alive by managing real needs: warmth, shelter, water, food, and safety. Craft primitive tools, build your hut from scratch, and learn to live off the land.

🦣 Massive Prehistoric Beasts
Face off against legendary animals: mammoths, smilodons (saber-toothed cats), giant birds, and elephant ancestors. Not all battles are winnable—sometimes, the best survival is to run.

👣 Evolve with Your Tribe
Start alone or form a tribe in multiplayer mode. Hunt together, build together, and grow stronger. Or fight over scarce resources in a brutal struggle for dominance.

🐺 Tame or Be Tamed
Some animals want to eat you. Others might stand by your side. With time and strategy, certain species can be tamed and used in your journey.

🌍 Massive Open World
Explore savannas, dense forests, volcanic valleys, and ancient rivers. Each biome comes with its own dangers, resources, and opportunities.

🔥 Deadly Nature
Survival is more than combat. Endure storms, drought, freezing cold, heatwaves, wildfires, and more. Nature is indifferent—and it will kill you if you’re unprepared.

🧬 Historically Inspired
Built on anthropological and evolutionary foundations, Primal Survival presents one of the most realistic prehistoric survival experiences ever created.

Primal Survival is not a fantasy—it’s how it might have really been.
Fight to live. Adapt to grow.
Are you the hunter… or the hunted?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 3600 or i5 8600k or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 6GB or AMD RX 590 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 5600X or Intel i5 12600k equivalent or greate
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 TI or AMD RX 6700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: A realistic prehistoric survival game where you play as Homo habilis or Homo erectus. Craft primitive tools, build shelter, hunt massive beasts, and survive the harsh forces of nature in a vast multiplayer world.
